Solidex is a DeFi protocol built on the Fantom blockchain. Solidex is derived from the Solidly decentralized exchange design. Solidex uses vote-escrowed token mechanics to lock governance and incentive tokens.

PoolTogether is a prize-linked savings protocol on public blockchains. PoolTogether pools user deposits and awards prizes through a lottery. PoolTogether is designed so that depositors can generally withdraw their principal without loss. PoolTogether runs on non-custodial smart contracts.

MOBOX is a GameFi and yield farming platform on the BNB Smart Chain. MOBOX offers DeFi staking and farming services linked to blockchain gaming.

Aerodrome Finance is a decentralized exchange on the Base blockchain. Aerodrome Finance is a fork of the Velodrome protocol. Aerodrome Finance uses a vote-escrowed token model to direct liquidity incentives.

yETH vault is a Yearn vault on the Ethereum blockchain. yETH vault holds a weighted pool of Ethereum liquid staking tokens. yETH vault automates yield strategies for its depositors through smart contracts.
